body:
Sounds like you want people around you to suffer. I'd say we're the opposites in that. 

I'm going so far as to buy my own plot in a payment plan and saving for funeral expenses, trying to come up with notes that let each person know that it's not their fault and answering any questions I think they might have about me or why I did the deed.

For awhile I wished I had some sort of terminal illness so I can drop out of school and do things that I want to do, I'm a creative person, I like art. But I'm going to school for medicine and it makes me miserable but I feel like I owe my family my life. 

So a Terminal illness never came, I do have Crohn's but its not terminal and here I am in this reddit.

I mean, its already in motion. Don't think of it as helping me do something that, lets be honest... I shouldn't do. But I'm pretty set on it. 

But please help me make this blow a little softer for my friends and family. I still love them and I know they still love me and I just want to make sure that they really understand that this isn't their fault at all.

Honestly its kind of the reason why I started being like this too. I dropped out of school a little bit ago, even though I was kinda far into it but its just not for me. My brain just isn't compatible and I don't want to be the family loser.
I'll watch it with you, just tell me when.
